title: Line sketch: Moonlit Silhouette
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A mysterious woman in an elegant flowing gown stands atop a cloud-like landscape, gazing at a giant moon. The surreal night scene features silhouetted buildings, trees, and a starry sky with a crescent moon (derived from painting #538).
